avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra (Ma Huang)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both are sympathomimetics; concurrent use increases risk of severe tachycardia, hypertension, arrhythmias, and cardiac events
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid all ephedra-containing products

avoid_supplements.name: Caffeine (high-dose supplements >400mg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive sympathomimetic effects; increases risk of tremor, tachycardia, and nervousness
avoid_supplements.action: Advise limitation of caffeine-containing supplements and energy products; monitor for increased side effects

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may increase salmeterol metabolism, potentially reducing efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor respiratory control; adjust dosing if indicated in consultation with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild sympathomimetic activity; may potentiate beta-agonist effects
caution_supplements.action: Counsel moderation; monitor for increased tremor or cardiovascular symptoms

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase salmeterol absorption rate; potential for higher peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Counsel consistent timing relative to meals; not a contraindication but maintain routine

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; may increase salmeterol exposure and systemic effects
caution_foods.action: Recommend avoidance or consistent minimal intake; monitor for increased tremor or palpitations

monitoring_notes: Salmeterol is primarily metabolized via CYP3A4; monitor for efficacy changes with enzyme-modulating supplements. Assess patients for sympathomimetic excess symptoms (tremor, tachycardia, anxiety) especially with concurrent stimulant use.
